mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM work) AS works, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM work WHERE type = 'ANIME') AS anime, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM work WHERE type = 'GAME') AS games, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM work WHERE type = 'ANIME' AND title_ko IS NOT NULL) AS title_ko_filled, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM anime_character) AS characters, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT wc.work_id) FROM work_character wc JOIN work w ON w.id = wc.work_id WHERE w.type = 'ANIME') AS anime_with_characters, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM voice_actor) AS voice_actors, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM studio) AS studios, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member) AS members, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member WHERE role = 'ADMIN') AS admins, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post) AS posts, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comment) AS comments
